# A ripple ring on the water where the frog lands (scaled up and hidden by the game).
new
add mesh torus --name Ring --major-segments 12 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.6 --minor-radius 0.05 --location 0 0 0.03
material new Foam --base-color 0.451 0.937 0.969
material assign Foam
shade flat
export ripple.glb
